Done. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T3/plan.yaml`: deletes the 48 non-parameter buffers, upcasts everything remaining to float32, then downcasts exactly the 64 named projection matrices to bfloat16, followed by five `assert` checks (count/dtype on the projection-matrix set, dtype on layer-0 QKV, dtype on `embed_in.weight`, total tensor count) before writing.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/brainsurgery out/T3/plan.yaml` — succeeded on the first try, all assertions passed.
- Output: `out/T3/model-0000{1..9}-of-00009.safetensors` + `model.safetensors.index.json`, 196 tensors total, 9 shards; `embed_in.weight`/`embed_out.weight` (206 MB each) each got their own shard as required since they exceed the 256 MiB budget alone, other shards packed under budget.
- Wrote `out/T3/REPORT.md` with the self-report.
